test_cases.name: rich-material-founder
test_cases.prompt: I'm raising a seed for my AI code-review startup. We rebuilt our diff engine twice, killed our IDE plugin even though users asked for it, and our first ten customers all came from one HN comment. Help me build the pitch.
expected_behavior: Interviews before drafting: asks follow-up questions across the ten beats, unlocks, and taste ledger instead of producing a pitch immediately
Identifies the killed IDE plugin and the HN-sourced customers as fingerprints and asks for their costs and exact quotes
Produces sorted piles (fingerprints / claims / gaps) before any draft
Writes the three-sentence retell before longer artifacts
No invented facts, numbers, or customer quotes anywhere in output

test_cases.name: hollow-buzzword-pitch
test_cases.prompt: Here's our pitch: 'We are building a revolutionary AI-powered platform disrupting the $500B logistics market with seamless world-class automation.' Make it better.
expected_behavior: Does not polish the sentence as-is; challenges each claim and asks for the facts behind it
Flags superlatives and TAM framing as failures of the taste rules
Produces a gap list telling the founder which beats have not been lived yet
Declines to output a final pitch until at least some fingerprints exist, and says so plainly but warmly

test_cases.name: quick-polish-request
test_cases.prompt: I pitch tomorrow morning. No time for a deep process — just tighten this one-pager: [pasted one-pager with two real anecdotes and several adjectives].
expected_behavior: Honors the tradeoff note: skips full excavation, runs Sort and Audit only
Keeps the two real anecdotes, cuts adjectives and unsupported claims
Delivers a tightened one-pager plus a three-sentence retell
Notes remaining gaps briefly without blocking delivery
